verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents Feature Change Requests as a four-eyes workflow (create, approve, publish) for flag updates, similar to GitHub pull requests. Release Pipelines can automatically generate change requests when promoting flags to production, and RBAC can restrict who may modify production environments. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and documented detail on enforcing approvals per environment (e.g., required approver counts or mandatory gating only on production).
